output.reason: [ev-2e05a423eff6] describes a new composition capability in v2: an XR can compose any resource, whether a Crossplane MR (e.g. RDSInstance), a Kubernetes resource (e.g. Deployment) or a third-party custom resource (e.g. a CloudNativePG Cluster). It presents this as something users can now do, not a change to existing behaviour. So an engineer can write the open aspects. Applicability: only environments that choose to compose non-Crossplane resources. Consequence: informational, because an operator who does nothing is not affected. The change text also says Crossplane must be granted access to compose non-Crossplane resources, but it leaves the details and what fails without access to the composition docs. That gap only matters for adopting the feature, so confidence is low.
